"""RoboPaint episode controller. Only public RGB/depth/proprio and motion API."""
import sys, json, pathlib, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); RUN=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
r=Robot()
Q=[0.,1.,0.,0.]
Z=.0202

def obs(name='obs',cams=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=False):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=cams,depth=depth); o.save(str(RUN/name))
    for c,im in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(RUN/name/(c+'.png'))
    return o

def submit(a,note='motion',cams=['canvas_cam','practice_cam'],dt=.05):
    a=np.asarray(a); num=len(list(OUT.glob('action_*.npz')))
    np.savez(OUT/f'action_{num:04d}.npz',actions=a,dt=dt,note=note)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=dt,video='none',cameras=cams,note=note)
    res.save(str(RUN/f'action_{num:04d}'))
    print(num,note,'tip',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3], 'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps'),'left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
    return res

def move(points,speed=.05,note='move'):
    start=r.get_obs(cameras=[]).group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3]; a=[]
    for pt in points:
        pt=np.array(pt); n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(pt-start)/speed/.05)))
        a.extend([list(p)+Q for p in np.linspace(start,pt,n+1)[1:]])
        start=pt
    a.extend([list(start)+Q]*10)
    for i in range(0,len(a),180): res=submit(a[i:i+180],note)
    return res

def park(): return move([[-.32,0,.12]],note='park')
if __name__=='__main__':
    park(); obs('park',depth=True)
